      • hasValue

        @PublishedMethod
public boolean hasValue()
        Returns true if the parameter exists and has a valid value.

        Note: This will return false, if the parameter has a value, but it is an invalid value according to the parameter definition. So this will return false, if getValue() would throw an BswmdModelParameterHasIllegalValueException.
